font-weight: 600; font-size: 64px; font-family: 'Inter'; text-anchor: start; fill: #ffffff
font-weight: 600; font-size: 28px; font-family: 'Inter'; text-anchor: start; fill: #ffffff

g.text: Yernur Kenzhegazin · Alan Berdigaliyev · Hugo Telles
M2 GENIOMHE-AI | Supervisor: Amaury Giard, IBISC

text.style: font-weight: 600; font-size: 29px; font-family: 'Inter'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #ffffff

g.text: We compare three chemical MLPs, retain ECFP4 by
validation, then compare it with retrained PRnet [1].
DMSO measurements anchor the response tests [2].

text.style: font-weight: 600; font-size: 24px; font-family: 'Inter'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #3f7895
font-weight: 600; font-size: 24px; font-family: 'Inter'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #b47c53

g.text: Figure 1. DMSO provides the reference; treated expression is the target.

text.style: font-weight: 600; font-size: 29px; font-family: 'Inter'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #ffffff
font-weight: 600; font-size: 23px; font-family: 'Inter'; text-anchor: start; fill: #ffffff

g.text: LINCS L1000: 978 measured genes, 10 µM, 24 h.
Match controls by plate, cell, time and bead batch;
average replicate expression for each gene.
Figure 2a. Averaging matched DMSO replicates gives 978 input values.

text.style: font-weight: 600; font-size: 23px; font-family: 'Inter'; text-anchor: start; fill: #ffffff

g.text: FCFP4: functional classes; ECFP4: atom environments.
ChemicalVAE: frozen SMILES features. Each MLP also
receives controls; PRnet uses dose-scaled FCFP4.
Figure 2b. Each chemical representation enters a separate predictor.

text.style: font-weight: 600; font-size: 23px; font-family: 'Inter'; text-anchor: start; fill: #ffffff

g.text: Use compound-disjoint splits and validation NLL.
Select ECFP4; adjust its learning rate using validation.
Compare the fitted models across three training seeds.
Figure 2c. Validation-based selection and ECFP4 learning-rate adjustment.

text.style: font-weight: 600; font-size: 29px; font-family: 'Inter'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #ffffff
font-weight: 600; font-size: 23px; font-family: 'Inter'; text-anchor: start; fill: #ffffff

g.text: A Validation selects the ECFP4 MLP
Three default MLPs · seed 42 · lower NLL is better
Figure 3. Lowest validation NLL for each default-setting MLP.
Each bar is one training run; no seed range is estimated.

text.style: font-weight: 600; font-size: 24px; font-family: 'Inter'; text-anchor: start; fill: #242426

g.text: All encodings were tuned in parallel. The validation ranking
identifies ECFP4 for this focused comparison.

text.style: font-weight: 600; font-size: 23px; font-family: 'Inter'; text-anchor: start; fill: #ffffff

g.text: B Test the selected MLP against PRnet

text.style: font-weight: 600; font-size: 23px; font-family: 'Inter'; text-anchor: start; fill: #242426
font-weight: 600; font-size: 23px; font-family: 'Inter'; text-anchor: start; fill: #242426

g.text: Figure 4. Treated-expression MSE; lower is better.
Bars: mean; dots: three seeds; whiskers: seed range.
DMSO is an unchanged-expression reference, not a fitted model.
ECFP4 has lower MSE than PRnet in both tests.
Unchanged DMSO is strongest on SKBR3.
A validation gain alone does not establish better transfer.

text.style: font-weight: 600; font-size: 23px; font-family: 'Inter'; text-anchor: start; fill: #ffffff

g.text: C External studies: evidence remains limited
Seven GEO studies · six gene directions per study
Figure 5. Correct directions across seven studies × six genes.
Bars: mean; points: three runs; whiskers: run range.
DMSO is the reference and does not make up/down predictions.
Only 15 of the 42 observed directions show clear changes.
No clear external advantage over PRnet is established.

text.style: font-weight: 600; font-size: 23px; font-family: 'Inter'; text-anchor: start; fill: #ffffff

g.text: D Control noise: ECFP4 stays below PRnet
Figure 6. Absolute SKBR3 MSE after noise is added to DMSO inputs.
Zero noise matches panel B; fitted weights and targets stay fixed.
20 draws/nonzero level; lines: means; bands: three-seed range.
DMSO is not trained and has no training-seed band.
At 1 replicate SD: ECFP4 MSE rises from 0.654 to 0.993;
PRnet rises from 2.176 to 2.229. ECFP4 remains lower.

text.style: font-weight: 600; font-size: 29px; font-family: 'Inter'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #ffffff

g.text: Selected ECFP4 has lower MSE than PRnet here.
Unchanged DMSO is stronger on unseen SKBR3.
Reliable external regulation prediction is not established.
One held-out cell line, a small external panel and
reused test sets make these findings exploratory.
Additional linear/mean baselines perform better; see report supplement.

text.style: font-weight: 600; font-size: 19px; font-family: 'Inter'; text-anchor: start; fill: #242426

g.text: [1] Qi et al. Nature Communications (2024). doi:10.1038/s41467-024-53457-1
